banner.title: {city}, in one click
banner.subtitle: The {city} Citizen Portal brings together the cultural agenda, municipal services and citizen participation in a single digital space. Transactions, bookings, alerts and much more, available 24 hours a day from any device.
banner.fnmtNote: Plus, if you hold a valid personal certificate issued by the FNMT, you can also take part in civic consultations.

easyRead.title: Easy read
easyRead.intro: This is what you can do on this portal, explained with simple words:
easyRead.p1: {city} has a website for its residents and visitors.
easyRead.p2: Here you can see events, tourist routes, alerts, book facilities and manage your car.
easyRead.p3: To use it, click the «Access the portal» button and sign in with your account.
easyRead.p4: If you need help, open the Help page from the top menu once you have signed in.
